name: manual_55b204
claim: Repowise has_test_file uses a same-basename heuristic, so treat 'untested hotspot' as an unverified signal and verify by searching behavior/contract-named tests before adding tests

decisions.notes: Repowise code-health scan marked 20+ Python hotspots as has_test_file:false. Root cause: it looks for test_<module>.py, while value_fabric tests use behavior/contract naming (test_guard, test_boundary, test_hostile). Reconcile first, add tests only for demonstrated gaps.
